```sql
SELECT tempo FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2024
  AND name LIKE 'Houston Cougars%'
```

```sql
SELECT attendance
FROM games
WHERE season = 2024
  AND game_type = 'ncaa_tournament'
  AND tourney_round = 'National Championship'
```

```sql
SELECT off_eff FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026
  AND name LIKE 'Michigan Wolverines%'
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(home_score + away_score) AS avg_combined_score
FROM games
WHERE season = 2025
```

```sql
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN margin > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS home_win_percentage
FROM games
WHERE season = 2021
  AND season_type = 2
  AND game_type = 'regular'
  AND neutral = 0
```

```sql
SELECT tourney_round, COUNT(*) AS games
FROM games
WHERE season = 2024 AND game_type = 'ncaa_tournament'
GROUP BY tourney_round
ORDER BY CASE tourney_round
  WHEN 'First Four' THEN 1
  WHEN '1st Round' THEN 2
  WHEN '2nd Round' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Sweet 16' THEN 4
  WHEN 'Elite 8' THEN 5
  WHEN 'Final Four' THEN 6
  WHEN 'National Championship' THEN 7
END
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_id)
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2020
```

```sql
SELECT ts.name, ts.rating
FROM team_seasons ts
JOIN games g ON ts.team_id IN (g.home_id, g.away_id) AND ts.season = g.season
WHERE g.season = 2024
  AND g.game_type = 'ncaa_tournament'
  AND g.tourney_round = '1st Round'
  AND ((g.home_id = ts.team_id AND g.margin < 0) OR (g.away_id = ts.team_id AND g.margin > 0))
ORDER BY ts.rating DESC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT 
  g.season,
  g.home_name AS champion,
  ts.rating_rank
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts ON ts.season = g.season AND ts.team_id = g.home_id
WHERE g.season BETWEEN 2021 AND 2026
  AND g.game_type = 'ncaa_tournament'
  AND g.tourney_round = 'National Championship'
  AND g.margin > 0
ORDER BY g.season
```

```sql
SELECT ts2.name, ts2.rating - ts1.rating AS rating_improvement
FROM team_seasons ts1
JOIN team_seasons ts2 ON ts1.team_id = ts2.team_id
WHERE ts1.season = 2025 AND ts2.season = 2026
ORDER BY rating_improvement DESC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT name, def_eff
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026
  AND (name LIKE 'Houston Cougars%' OR name LIKE 'Tennessee Volunteers%')
ORDER BY def_eff ASC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT name, orb_pct
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2024
  AND (name LIKE 'Kansas Jayhawks%' OR name LIKE 'Kentucky Wildcats%')
ORDER BY orb_pct DESC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT 
  home_name,
  away_name,
  home_score,
  away_score,
  home_score + away_score AS combined_points,
  date
FROM games
WHERE season = 2026
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 5
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(win) AS wins, SUM(1 - win) AS losses
FROM team_games
WHERE season = 2026
  AND team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Arizona Wildcats%')
  AND date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
```

```sql
SELECT ts.name, COUNT(*) AS march_wins
FROM team_games tg
JOIN team_seasons ts ON ts.season = tg.season AND ts.team_id = tg.team_id
WHERE tg.season = 2025
  AND tg.date BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-31'
  AND tg.win = 1
GROUP BY tg.team_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY march_wins DESC
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(home_score + away_score) AS average_combined_score
FROM games
WHERE date >= '2026-03-01'
```
